description: This PHP script manages the removal of Access Control List (ACL) actions for modules in a SugarCRM/SuiteCRM environment. It checks for administrator privileges, iterates over default actions, and removes ACL modules if certain conditions are met.

methods.name: ACLAction::getDefaultActions
methods.description: Retrieves the list of default ACL actions. It returns an array of action objects, each with properties like name and category.

methods.name: ACLAction::removeActions
methods.description: Removes ACL actions for a specified module category.
